arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Michael McConnell argued that Hastings' policy allows non-believers to lead Bible studies.
He claimed the policy is absurd and applies to the law school itself.
Paul Garre argued both lower courts decided the case on the all-comers premise.
He stated this premise was not disputed in the petition for certiorari.
